text:
Riya (PM): Quick sync — need final launch gates for the multi-region + tenant-isolation work. Q2 planning window closes Friday.

Anya (Arch): We should codify what "isolation" means operationally: zero-cross-region by default, isolated capacity pool, and deterministic fallback paths.

Jorge (Infra): From infra side minimal telemetry: token p50/p95, request QPS per pool, KV cache hit/miss, cross-region egress/sec, GPU util percentiles.

Sam (SRE): Operational rules: canary window 30m, rollback if error budget +2% within 10m, and synthetic health checks every 15s for route correctness.

Kai (Sales): Customer asks summary: three midmarket customers need EU-only routing, one enterprise wants contractual isolation and runbook. They want a drift detection report monthly.

Riya (PM): Draft gates proposal:
- Perf: p95 token latency <= 1s for 1.5k token median workloads
- Reliability: sustained error rate < 0.4% during 30m canary
- Affinity: isolated lane tenant affinity >= 99% (measured over 24h dry-run)
- Failover: automated cross-region fallback completes < 10s and is audited
- Cost: projected per-token cost uplift <= 20% for isolated pools

Anya (Arch): Add policy-as-code requirement. Example snippet for Sales/PS to map asks: 
```yaml
policies:
  - id: eu_finance_isolation
    match: region == "eu" and customer_tier == "enterprise"
    apply: route: eu-isolated-pool
    audit: true
```

Jorge (Infra): Cost uplift depends on batching and KV cache locality. I'll run cost sims against seq-length histograms and attach results.

Sam (SRE): Need a 72h dry-run mode where routing evals are logged but traffic not switched — we can compute affinity and detect unseen edge cases. Ops will require a dry-run flag in rollout tooling.

Kai (Sales): I'll confirm exact customer count and escalate one RFP. Also customers asked for an SLA clause that isolation is "best-effort" vs "contracted" — legal will weigh in.

DeployBot: upload: 1767002250-seq-histograms-sample.csv :white_check_mark:

Riya (PM): Next steps: I'll produce a one-pager with the gates + acceptance checklist. Jorge — cost sims by Tue. Sam — draft canary/rollback playbook. Kai — customer counts + SLA asks by EOD. Sync Thursday 9am.

Anya (Arch): Also recommend a migration path: 1) dry-run, 2) canary 5% traffic, 3) progressive ramp to 50% with affinity monitoring, 4) full cutover. Include automated evict threshold if affinity drops > 1.5%.

Sam (SRE): +1. I'll add runbook snippets and alert thresholds.

Riya (PM): Thanks all — I'll post the one-pager to the channel when ready. :thumbsup:
__notes: Cross-functional Slack thread: product/architecture/infra/SRE sync on routing policies, isolation launch gates and acceptance criteria. No title field per agents.md.
